records.title: Adaptive Spiking Neurons for Vision and Language Modeling
records.reason: Adaptive Spiking Neurons add learnable layer-wise membrane thresholds; 19 vision/language datasets are evaluated. Energy estimates are theoretical, not measured on neuromorphic hardware, with DVS validation left open. General SNNs do not establish generative LLM inference performance; weak architecture adjacency only.

records.title: Do Transformers Use their Depth Adaptively? Evidence from a Relational Reasoning Task
records.reason: The study probes adaptive transformer depth on synthetic CLUTRR family-relation chains (2–10 hops) using single-token answers. It analyzes layer use rather than proposing an early-exit/dynamic-depth method; no latency/compute savings are measured. The adaptive-inference connection is weak.

records.title: FreqFormer: Hierarchical Frequency-Domain Attention with Adaptive Spectral Routing for Long-Sequence Video Diffusion Transformers
records.reason: FreqFormer optimizes long-sequence video diffusion transformers, not language-model inference.

records.title: Optimizing document retrieval using massive text embeddings and LLM prompt engineering
records.reason: Text-embedding literature retrieval is not a concrete LLM inference-cost improvement.

records.title: From Topology to Trajectory: LLM-Driven World Models For Supply Chain Resilience
records.reason: LLM supply-chain planning addresses application resilience, not inference efficiency.
